rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice, especially when someone makes something extend outward, as in 將 A 伸出嚟.

example.english: Don't let your hand protrude from the car window.
example.traditional: 唔好將隻手伸出車窗外。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 zoeng1 zek3 sau2 san1 ceot1 ce1 coeng1 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this when something is visibly sticking or projecting out from a surface or boundary, as in A 凸出嚟.

example.english: The tile wasn't laid evenly, and one corner seems to protrude.
example.traditional: 塊瓷磚鋪得唔平，有一角凸出嚟。
example.jyutping: faai3 ci4 zyun1 pou1 dak1 m4 ping4 jau5 jat1 gok3 dat6 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when the protrusion has a rounded, bulging, or arched shape rather than simply extending straight out.

example.english: The middle of the cake seems to protrude like a little hill.
example.traditional: 個蛋糕焗到中間拱出嚟，好似座小山咁。
example.jyutping: go3 daan6 gou1 guk6 dou3 zung1 gaan1 gung2 ceot1 lai4 hou2 ci5 zo6 siu2 saan1 gam3
